name: doaj-preassessment
description: Independent pilot for evidence-based preparation of a DOAJ journal application using a frozen criteria baseline.

interface.shortDescription: Review public journal evidence before a DOAJ application.
interface.longDescription: An independent, skills-only pilot that guides a URL-only review against the bundled October 2026 criteria baseline. It does not represent DOAJ or predict its decision.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my journal homepage for DOAJ application preparation.
